_meta.description: Synthetic inbound lead form submissions for Northwind Analytics (a fictional B2B SaaS support-analytics product). Hand-written, not templated, so phrasing, length, tone and messiness vary the way real form fills do.
_meta.domains: All email domains use the RFC 2606 reserved .example TLD so no synthetic record can collide with a real domain.
_meta.unlabeled: Deliberately contains NO tier or field labels. Labels are produced by a human against docs/RUBRIC.md and stored separately in data/labels.json. If the labels were generated by a model, evaluating a model against them would measure self-agreement rather than correctness.

leads.message: I'm the VP of Customer Experience here. We run about 60 support agents across two sites and our current reporting is a weekly CSV someone builds by hand. I need to show the exec team resolution time by queue before our Q4 planning offsite, which is in three weeks. Can we get a demo this week?
hi do you have pricing on your website? couldnt find it

Hello — I lead support operations for a 1,200-person insurance group. We're evaluating three vendors this quarter and have budget approved for a 2027 start. Our main pain is that we can't attribute CSAT drops to specific ticket types. Who should I speak to about a technical evaluation?

Hi there, I'm a support team lead at Ravensbourne. I saw you're hiring a solutions engineer — I've been in CX tooling for six years and would love to be considered. Is there someone on the talent side I can send my CV to?

Director of Customer Service. 300ish employees, support team of about 25. Honestly just starting to look at what's out there, no firm timeline. What makes you different from the dashboards our helpdesk already ships with?

Hi — we build support analytics too (Brightpath CX). I'm doing competitive research ahead of our Series A and wanted to see a demo of how you handle transcript ingestion. Happy to do a mutual walkthrough.

We're a wholesale distributor, around 800 staff. Our head of support left last month and I'm covering the function as COO. Tickets are piling up and nobody can tell me why handle time doubled. Need something in place before the holiday peak — that's eight weeks out. What does implementation look like?

Hello! I'm a final-year information systems student writing my dissertation on AI in customer service operations. Would anyone be willing to do a 30-minute interview about how your product works? It's purely academic, nothing commercial.
interested

Chief Customer Officer at Aldergate (roughly 4,000 employees, 150 support agents across UK and Ireland). We've just signed off a CX transformation programme and analytics is workstream two. I'd like to start procurement conversations immediately — we have a six-figure budget line for tooling this financial year.
Good morning. We are a small family workshop, six people. My wife answers the emails from customers. Is your software something that could help us or is it only for the big companies? Thank you.

Head of Service Operations. 2,500 employees. We have a regulatory reporting requirement landing in March and our current tooling can't produce an audit trail for complaint handling times. This is not optional for us. Can someone walk me through how your reporting handles audit and retention?

Support agent here. Our manager asked me to look into tools that could help us report on ticket backlog. I don't make the decisions but I'm putting together a shortlist for her. We're about 400 people, support team of 12. No idea on timing, she just said 'see what's out there'.

Hi Northwind team — we're a demand-gen agency specialising in B2B SaaS. I noticed your site doesn't have retargeting set up. We've helped similar companies lift demo bookings 40%. Open to a quick chat about how we could help you grow?

Customer Service Manager, utilities, about 900 staff. We handle around 40,000 contacts a month across phone, email and webchat. The thing I actually care about is whether agents are being pulled into repeat contacts that should have been solved first time. Is first-contact resolution something you measure properly or is it a vanity number in your product too?

VP Customer Operations. Large pharma, 6,000+ globally. I'm exploring the space generally — no project, no budget, no timeline. I keep a list of vendors I might want in 18 months. Send me whatever overview material you have and I'll file it.

Director of Player Support. ~700 employees, support org of 45 plus outsourced overflow. Our problem is the outsourcer's reporting doesn't reconcile with ours and we're arguing about SLA credits every month. We want to be live on something neutral before our next contract renewal in January. Budget's agreed in principle.
I bought a washing machine and the support from the retailer has been appalling. Is this the company that handles their complaints? I want to log a formal complaint about how long I waited.

Support Operations Analyst. 1,100 employees. I've been asked to produce a build-vs-buy paper for our leadership by the end of October. I need to understand your data model and whether we can export raw events into our warehouse, because that'll be the deciding factor. Who handles technical questions?

Hi, Head of Consumer Care. 450 staff. Can you tell me if you integrate with Zendesk and Genesys? That's the blocker for us — if you don't, there's no conversation to have. If you do, I'd like to move quickly, we're replacing our reporting stack this quarter.

I'm an independent CX consultant. One of my clients — a 2,000-person healthcare provider — is struggling to measure deflection after rolling out a chatbot. They've asked me to shortlist analytics vendors. They'd want to be live by end of Q1 and have allocated spend. Can I get a partner or referral conversation going?

Hei! Vi er et skipsfartsselskap med cirka 600 ansatte. Kundeserviceteamet vårt på 20 personer sliter med å rapportere svartid på tvers av kanaler. Jeg er leder for kundeservice og ønsker en demo i løpet av de neste to ukene. Snakker dere norsk, eller kan vi møtes på engelsk?
need a demo asap

Hello — I'm Head of Support at Lumenshift, we're a 90-person B2B software company with a support team of 8. We're growing fast and the spreadsheet approach has stopped working. Nothing urgent, we're planning for next year, but I'd like to understand what good looks like at our size before we commit to anything.
CONGRATULATIONS!!! Your site has been selected for FREE SEO AUDIT. Click here to claim >>> [link] [link] [link] Rank #1 on Google guaranteed. Reply STOP to unsubscribe. Also buy crypto.

Operations Director for a multi-academy trust, 1,800 staff across 14 schools. We field a lot of parent enquiries through a shared inbox and have no visibility at all on response times. I don't know if we count as a 'support team' in your terms — we don't have agents as such, just admin staff. Would your product even apply to us?

Contact centre manager. 3,000 employees group-wide, my centre is 80 seats. We've got money set aside this year for workforce analytics and I've been told to pick something by November. Can you cover agent occupancy and shrinkage as well as ticket metrics, or is it purely ticket-side?

Hi, I'm a product manager here (not support). Our support team keeps complaining they can't prove where the friction is in onboarding, and I think better analytics would help my roadmap too. We're 600 people. Is this the kind of thing a PM can champion or do I need to get our support director involved?

Good afternoon. I am the Director of Member Services at a mutual insurer, approximately 1,400 employees. I will be blunt: we have been burned by two analytics vendors who promised integration and delivered a CSV export. Before I spend any time on a demo I want to know precisely which systems you integrate with natively and whether you have a reference customer in financial services I can speak to.

Hello. I am currently a Customer Service Team Manager but I am looking to move into the vendor side. Do you have any openings for implementation consultants or customer success managers? I have nine years of contact centre experience and would be very interested in Northwind. My CV is attached.

VP of Customer Experience, 5,000 employees, 200 agents. Straightforward ask: our board wants a single number for 'support efficiency' each month and nobody can agree what it should be. I want a vendor who'll argue with me about the right metric, not just build whatever dashboard I describe. Are you that kind of company? Timeline is this quarter, budget exists.

Customer Services Manager at a housing association, 350 staff. Our tenants contact us by phone, email, the portal and increasingly WhatsApp. Leadership wants a single view. I have no budget authority but I'm the one who'd use it daily and my director has asked me to find options. We'd want something next financial year.

Hello. I run an antiques business with my son. We get perhaps ten customer emails a week. Someone suggested we should be 'measuring our customer service'. I suspect we are too small for you but thought I would ask.

Head of Client Services, legal services firm, 700 people. We're mid-way through a Salesforce Service Cloud rollout and our implementation partner has told us the native reporting won't give us what we need. We go live in six weeks. I need to know today whether you can sit on top of Service Cloud without a long integration project. If you can, I'll find the budget.
Support engineer. Just curious what your product does, a colleague mentioned it. No particular project in mind.

Director of Customer Operations. We're a mobility/scooter-share operator, 450 staff, support team of 30 handling a lot of in-app incident reports. Our seasonality is brutal and we over- or under-staff every single month. If you can help us forecast contact volume I'd want to start in the next few weeks. We have money for it.
Hi. Do you have an API?

Bonjour, je suis responsable du service client pour une maison de cosmétiques (environ 250 employés, 15 conseillers clientèle). Nous cherchons à comprendre pourquoi notre taux de satisfaction baisse depuis six mois alors que nos délais de réponse se sont améliorés. Avez-vous une solution pour analyser le contenu des échanges et pas seulement les délais ? Nous aimerions avancer ce trimestre.

Hi — I'm the founder of Mandeville Analytics. We're in an adjacent space (we do agent coaching analytics). I'd like to explore whether there's a partnership or integration story here. Could we set up a call between our product teams?

Director of Patient Access. 2,200 employees. Patient contact is split across three call centres that were separate organisations until a merger last year. Nobody can produce a consolidated view and the CEO has asked for one by year end. This is my top priority. Budget is not the constraint, time is.

Customer care supervisor, 180 staff, support team of 9. We've never used anything like this. I'm not sure what questions I should even be asking. Is there something I could read first before wasting a salesperson's time?

Head of Audience Support. 1,600 employees. We've shortlisted you and two competitors. Our evaluation criteria are weighted toward transcript-level analysis and we need a decision by the end of next month. Can you commit to a technical deep-dive and a sandbox with our data within two weeks? If not, please say so and I'll save us both the time.

I'm in procurement, not support. Our head of shared services asked me to request pricing from three vendors for 'support analytics'. I don't have detail on the requirement. 3,500 employees. Can you send a price list?

Head of Complaints Handling at a retail bank, 4,500 employees. Regulatory pressure is increasing on complaint root-cause reporting and our current approach is manual sampling. We need automated themes across 100% of complaints, not a 2% sample. Immediate priority, funded, and I'd like to have selected a vendor within six weeks.
Hello. I am a letting agent. Sometimes tenants complain. Do you fix that?

Head of Guest Services, 1,100 employees, support team of 60 that triples in summer. Two questions that will decide this for us: can you handle seasonal headcount without per-seat pricing punishing us, and do you support Dutch and German transcript analysis? We're budgeting now for a Q1 start.

Support Operations Lead. 950 employees. Genuinely interested but I should be upfront — we just signed a two-year deal with another vendor in July. I'd like to keep in touch for when that comes up for renewal, and honestly I'd like to understand what we might have got wrong in our selection. Worth a conversation?

Customer Services Lead, local authority, 2,800 staff. We have a statutory duty to report on complaint handling and our current process takes three people a week every month. Procurement here is slow — it would be a formal tender — but I want to understand the market before we write the specification. Realistically a 2027 implementation.

CX Director. 3,200 employees. I'll be honest, I filled this in because your content on contact deflection was good and I wanted to see if the product matched the writing. No project, no budget, not looking to buy. If you want to send me something useful rather than a sales sequence, I'd read it.

Head of Customer Care, food manufacturer, 1,900 employees. Consumer complaints spike whenever there's a product recall and we're completely blind to early signals. If you could show me that you'd have caught our last recall two weeks earlier from contact patterns, I'd sign tomorrow. We have budget and executive sponsorship. When can we talk?
